title: Area-code shard C pass 18 — 530 / 539 / 551
summary: Bounded shard-C area-code enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 530, 539, and 551 with public-role person cross-enumeration.

provenance.method: bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration with public-role person cross-enumeration

data.research_question: Which current public organizations, communications surfaces, and publicly identifiable organizational-role people can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 530, 539, and 551?
data.method: Current NANPA geographic admission, deterministic NPA mod 3 == 2 sharding, literal and locality-derived public-source searches, historical-directory discovery only, current-status verification, repository dedupe, public identifier enumeration, and public-role person cross-enumeration.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational role, participation, proximity, attendance, volunteering, or membership.
Do not merge people or organizations from name or handle similarity alone.
Overlay locality relations for 539/551 are geographic discovery relations and do not assert an organization publishes that NPA unless directly evidenced.
Person-org relations in this pass are explicit public organizational roles; weak pseudonym-only or single-signal cases were not promoted.

findings.notes: Davis Food Not Bombs and Davis Night Market retained as current. Davis FNB has recurring public service plus Instagram/Facebook/email. Davis Night Market is a current weeknight food-recovery mutual-aid organization; two volunteers are explicitly named in 2025 public reporting.

Tulsa Food Not Bombs and Tulsa Really Really Free Market retained as current. FNB's public Linktree has 2026 volunteer/mailing-list surfaces and linked Facebook/Instagram/X/email. Tulsa RRFM has a current Linktree and March 2026 corroboration as a monthly mutual-aid event. NPA 539 overlays 918.

Jersey City Mutual Aid Society and Food Not Bombs JC retained as current. JCMAS first-party About identifies Amy Wilson as the project starter/founder. FNB JC has current 2026 distributions and public Linktree/Instagram/email surfaces. NPA 551 overlays 201.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization enumeration pass with public-role person cross-enumeration
